verdict.rationale: Datalab is API-first and can run without a UI. It documents an official CLI with non-interactive commands such as `datalab convert document.pdf --format html --mode accurate`, a Python SDK, REST endpoints, and an API-key health check. Webhooks remove the need for polling, and a Helm chart supports self-hosted containers, which together cover unattended automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions or pipeline examples, documented env-var/non-interactive auth for the CLI), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
